Implicitly constructs a color linked to a style color-table entry. Implicitly constructs a copy of a named core-style brush. Implicitly constructs a solid-color brush.

inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
